_national.labelling: Three regional PDOs (Istočna kontinentalna Hrvatska, Zapadna kontinentalna Hrvatska, Primorska Hrvatska) with 12 subregional PDOs (e.g. Slavonija, Plešivica, Hrvatska Istra, Dalmatinska zagora) and small single-area PDOs such as Dingač. Quality levels: kvalitetno vino KZP (quality wine of controlled geographical origin; may add Mlado vino or Arhivsko vino) and vrhunsko vino KZP (superior; Arhivsko vino = at least five years in the cellar, three in bottle). Predicate wines (vrhunsko only): Kasna berba (late harvest, at least 94 Oe), Izborna berba (105 Oe), Izborna berba bobica (127 Oe, botrytised), Izborna berba prosušenih bobica (154 Oe, dried berries), Ledeno vino (ice wine, picked below minus 7 C, 127 Oe). Sparkling: vrhunsko pjenušavo vino; semi-sparkling: kvalitetno biser vino.
_national.min_alcohol: Natural alcohol at least 9% for kvalitetno vino (enrichment by must or concentrate only, max 4%) and 10.5% for vrhunsko vino (no enrichment, sweetening, acidification or deacidification) in the Slavonija specification.
_national.max_yield: Slavonija: 12,000 kg/ha (8,400 l) for kvalitetno, 11,000 kg/ha (6,600 l) for vrhunsko; Hrvatska Istra: 12,000 and 11,000 kg/ha.

hr-dingac.min_alcohol: Actual alcohol at least 13.5%; total up to 18%.
hr-dingac.ageing: Klasiko: at least 12 months, of which 9 in wood and 3 in bottle. Riserva: at least 24 months, of which 18 in wood and 6 in bottle.
hr-dingac.labelling: On the steep south-west face of the Pelješac peninsula (7.58 km2, slopes of 10 to 60 degrees). Goblet-trained vines without wires, up to 10,000 vines/ha; terrace walls must use local stone and no soil may be brought in. Winemaking and bottling allowed only within the municipalities of Orebić and Trpanj. Site names (85% rule) in letters at least 50% smaller than "Dingač". Dark green or brown glass bottles only, in listed sizes.

hr-hrvatska-istra.varieties: Main varieties include Malvazija istarska and Teran, plus international varieties.
hr-hrvatska-istra.max_yield: 12,000 kg/ha for kvalitetno vino KZP, 11,000 kg/ha for vrhunsko vino KZP.
hr-hrvatska-istra.labelling: The variety name "Teran" may be used only for this PDO, in the same field of vision as "Hrvatska Istra" and in smaller letters. Teran wines may include at most 15% other varieties for rosé or sparkling, 10% for young wine and 5% for aged Teran.

hr-slavonija.varieties: Graševina (Welschriesling) dominates; other whites include Chardonnay, Kerner, Manzoni Bianco and others.
hr-slavonija.max_yield: 12,000 kg/ha (8,400 l) for kvalitetno vino, 11,000 kg/ha (6,600 l) for vrhunsko vino.
